value.x-unique-key: organization_id + classification stable id + cash_transaction stable id + salary_pool stable id + payment_component; historical row key excludes reference versions and request/idempotency keys
organization_id + original classification stable id; each original payroll link reversed at most once
organization_id + original internal transfer stable id; excludes request key/version

schema_patch_blueprint.value: Historical identity is organization_id + classification stable id; at most one effective classification per organization + cash stable id. Effective excludes only classifications with a valid full append-only reversal; retain all originals and reversals.

canonical_ownership.cash: cash owns all new relations; costing resolves immutable pools only.

keys.CashClassification: cash/cash_classification/{id}/{version}; historical identity includes classification stable id. At most one EFFECTIVE classification per organization + cash stable id, never permanent cash uniqueness. Originals/reversals remain immutable; transfer-classified cash cannot classify separately while effective.
keys.PayrollCashLink: cash/payroll_cash_link/{id}/{version}; historical row key = organization + classification stable id + cash stable id + pool stable id + component. Cross-classification effective duplicate/occupancy checks run under company lock, excluding only strictly reversed originals.
keys.InternalTransfer: cash/internal_transfer/{id}/{version}; unique organization + unordered distinct cash stable-id pair; each leg unique among active transfers
keys.SourceConsumption: core/source_consumption uses canonical command source plus natural relationship keys; source reuse with changed payload conflicts
keys.CashClassificationReversal: cash/cash_classification_reversal/{id}/{version}; unique original classification stable id; embedded reversal unique original link id
keys.InternalTransferReversal: cash/internal_transfer_reversal/{id}/{version}; unique original transfer stable id; child classification reversals reuse unique original-classification ids

canonical_ownership.reference_rules: Reject reference aliases; limits and natural uniqueness use stable ids, never version/request key.

common: Owner/finance authenticated service only. PM/employee cannot write/read salary links; redact queries/errors/events/logs. No personal PAT/AI approval tools.
Organization derives from CommandContext; tenant-match source, account, cash, pools and evidence. Never trust client organization/approver.
PG lock order: company -> all periods -> pools/cash stable-id order -> source/relationship uniqueness. Recheck auth, versions, state and sums in transaction.
source identifies command provenance, never bank/pool provenance. Same key+normalized input returns original after auth; changed input conflicts. New key cannot bypass natural uniqueness.

occurred_on <= business today; posting_period contains it and is open. Check every original cash posting period open and actual date <= today. Preserve dates; locked-period correction requires separate workflow.
Require exact immutable and current effective reference version. Reject stale/superseded/reversed refs. Replay returns original immutable receipt without new event.
Commit relationships+audit+source consumption+outbox atomically; fail all. dry_run defaults true before hashing, checks all, persists nothing and returns empty refs/event_ids.
created returns root ref+one event; existing returns original ref+event. Zero new AccountingEvent/LedgerPosting/cash.transaction_recorded; posting_event_refs empty.
classification: Existing imported active/posted cash with immutable bank provenance only. Zero new cash/cost/revenue. Reject conflicting classification, clearance, refund/return/transfer; new-key identical business write is DUP_RELATION.
Payroll: out cash and >=1 link. Other allowed categories: no links. tax has no pool link in this slice. Fee/transfer excluded here.

Pools: same tenant, approved/reconciled, immutable valid version, not planned-only. Employee payee matches pool employee. Organization batch may span employees only with bank evidence and finance component verification.

Each linked_cents is factual share of THIS payment; cash-wide sum <= effective gross_cents. Never infer payable/bank balance from pool total; multiple distinct actual payments may reference same pool without pool-total cap.

Historical PayrollCashLink unique key includes classification stable id + organization/cash/pool/component; preserve old rows and keys after reversal. Under company/cash lock compute effective projection by excluding ONLY originals covered by valid full append-only reversal and exact original-link reversal rows. Reject duplicate cash/pool/component across effective classifications or repeated rows within a request, including version aliases; cash-wide effective occupancy and allocations <= actual cash. Residual stays explicitly unlinked. A fresh classification after full reversal may reuse the same cash/pool/component with a new classification stable id; neither version nor request key changes the original bank source identity.
Append classification+links atomically; no replacement. Correction uses cash.classification.reverse/v1 then a fresh record. Event includes root+links; no pool details.
internal_transfer: Imported active/posted distinct same-enterprise legs, different accounts, CNY, opposite directions, equal positive gross. Reject missing/same leg, same account/direction, unequal amounts. No fee balancing leg.
Legs unclassified/unmatched, unallocated, unused by effective transfer/clearance/refund/return. Append pair+two transfer classifications atomically; never alter bank facts/ledger.

Unique unordered pair and unique active leg membership regardless of request key/order. Race loser rolls back both classifications. Unmatched supersession uses append-only version relation, no overwrite.

transfer_date=relationship occurred_on. out_transaction_date/in_transaction_date copy bank dates. Different days allowed if open: preserve daily actuals; window nets zero only if both legs included. Disclose in-transit cutoff coverage, never force each day zero.
Event changed_refs=transfer+two classifications. Zero new cash/cost/revenue/ledger; both original flows remain visible.
classification_reverse: Owner/finance application service only; common auth/tenant/lock/period/version/source/idempotency/dry_run rules apply. No PM/employee/PAT. source=correction provenance; payload target=original classification.

Resolve original immutable classification, original cash and ALL its payroll links under company lock; check exact current effective classification version. Reject foreign tenant, reversed/superseded target, future occurred_on/cash date, or locked original cash/classification/link posting period or reversal posting period. Dates preserved.

Full reversal only. Client supplies no released amounts, cash amounts, pool amounts or editable balance. Server snapshots every original active link and released_cents=original linked_cents. Append one CashClassificationReversal with all embedded reversal rows, audit, source consumption and one outbox event in same transaction; no update/delete original classification/links.

Effective classification is absent after reversal. Effective payroll occupancy is sum(original links) minus sum(valid linked reversal rows); never directly edit balance or SalaryPool. New record may classify the same cash after reversal, with a new classification id; natural uniqueness means one EFFECTIVE classification, not a permanent cash ban.

Zero new cash/cost/revenue/AccountingEvent/LedgerPosting, no bank fact/date/source change and no refund event. Result root is reversal ref; event source=root; changed_refs=[root], original_classification_ref and reversed_payroll_link_refs identify unchanged originals. Do not publish released wage amounts to broad event subscribers.

If original classification participates in InternalTransfer, clearance, cash allocation, refund/return or any active downstream relation, reject DEPENDENT_RELATION. First use that dependency owner approved reversal workflow in dependency order; if none exists remain blocked, never partially unlink or auto-refund. InternalTransfer-generated classifications cannot be individually reversed.

Business uniqueness: one full reversal per original classification id, one reversed embedded row per original link id, ignoring key/version aliases. Same-key same-input returns original receipt; changed input conflicts; new-key duplicate is ALREADY_REVERSED. Concurrent reverse/reverse or reverse/new-link uses company lock and SQL uniqueness so only one effective release; race loser fully rolls back.
Reverse cash10000 links7000+3000: occupancy released10000; original cash/cost unchanged. Fresh record remains bounded by actual cash and other allocations.
internal_transfer_reverse: Owner/finance authenticated application service only; all common authorization/tenant/version/source/idempotency/dry_run/date/period checks apply. No personal PAT tool. Payload selects one immutable effective transfer, not client-provided legs/amounts.

Under company PostgreSQL lock resolve original pair, both immutable leg classifications, bank facts and ALL associated payroll links; stable-id lock ordering as common rules. Verify original transfer and each class belong to same organization, versions remain effective, original and correction periods open, all original cash and occurred_on dates <= business today.

Append one InternalTransferReversal and exactly two CashClassificationReversal children atomically with audit/source consumption/outbox. Reuse existing classification reversal entity shape and unique original-link reversal rows: each child records server-resolved original class/cash, reason/evidence and complete original payroll link list with released_cents=original linked_cents. Valid transfer-generated classes normally have zero payroll links; unexpected payroll occupancy is an integrity error and rolls back, never silently drops links.

Internal service bypasses only the dependency check for THIS target pair while creating both children. Never expose that bypass to classification.reverse or clients. Any OTHER effective transfer, settlement/clearance/allocation/refund/return dependency rejects DEPENDENT_RELATION until its owner legally reverses it. Pair and both classifications stay effective if any check fails.

Effective transfer/leg-classification occupancy derives from original facts minus these append-only reversals. Restore both legs for later valid linking only after commit. Never edit/delete/unlink original records, direct balances or ledger; do not synthesize refund, cash, revenue or cost. Original SourceRefs and bank facts remain retrievable.

Single root command produces one internal_transfer_reversed event only; child reversals are internal records, not nested commands/events. created/existing result returns one root ref and one root event id; changed_refs contains root+both child reversals, classification_reversal_refs has the same two distinct children. Original refs in events are lineage, not edited facts.

One reversal per original pair and one per original classification/link, independent of caller key/version aliases. Same key+same normalized input replays original receipt; changed input conflicts; new-key duplicate ALREADY_REVERSED. PG pair/leg locks plus unique constraints make reverse/reverse and reverse/relink races atomic; losing operation commits nothing.

Original different bank dates remain unchanged before/after reversal and subsequent relinking. Daily actual cash remains on original leg dates; no period is forced to net zero and no historical cash restatement follows relation correction.
